lead: President Tinubu ordered an investigation into the deaths of detained mining suspects in Niger State, where the government cancelled an APC rally and suspended the Civil Defence commandant. The ICC tribunal's Mambilla award highlighted a $500,000 payment to Atiku Abubakar's former wife, and the APC campaign told him to quit the race. The Court of Appeal reversed the deregistration of Peter Obi's NDC, the current account surplus rose 68 per cent to $7.54 billion, and the stock market passed N162 trillion for the first time.

items.h: Tinubu orders probe of mining suspects' deaths; Niger cancels APC rally
items.s: The Federal Government promised an impartial investigation and prosecution over the deaths of people held after illegal mining raids. Niger State cancelled Saturday's APC rally in Minna and suspended the NSCDC commandant after 37 detainees died.

items.h: Mambilla award flags $500,000 payment to Atiku's ex-wife; APC tells him to quit
items.s: The ICC tribunal said a $500,000 transfer in 2003 to Atiku Abubakar's then wife by a witness's company raised significant red flags. The APC presidential campaign council called on Atiku to withdraw from the race.

items.h: Appeal Court reverses deregistration of Obi's NDC
items.s: In a 2-1 judgment, the Court of Appeal in Abuja overturned a Lokoja High Court decision that had set aside the order for INEC to register the Nigeria Democratic Congress.

items.h: Current account surplus rises 68% to $7.54bn
items.s: Stronger exports of crude, gas and refined products, together with remittances, lifted Nigeria's surplus in the second quarter of 2026.

items.h: NGX market value passes N162trn for first time
items.s: Equities capitalisation closed at a record N162.16 trillion.

items.h: Macron hosts Tinubu at private dinner in Paris
items.s: The French President held a private dinner for President Tinubu at the Elysee Palace on Thursday night, the Presidency said.

items.h: FG and CBN sign pact on fiscal and monetary coordination
items.s: The government and the Central Bank signed a memorandum in Abuja to formalise coordination of their policies.

items.h: INEC begins recruiting 1.4 million ad hoc staff
items.s: The commission started hiring temporary workers for the 2027 general elections.

items.h: Foreign minister warns envoys against unguarded comments on elections
items.s: Bianca Odumegwu-Ojukwu told diplomatic missions to avoid disparaging remarks or lectures on democracy before 2027.

items.h: Bandits kill 13 in three Zamfara villages
items.s: At least 13 people died in Dansadau Emirate, Maru, after reprisals for the killing of a bandit leader by local fighters.

items.h: Mother and children die in Okrika house fire
items.s: A woman and her children died when fire engulfed their home in Okochiri community on Friday. Early reports said four children died; police later put the toll at the mother and three children.

items.h: Atiku urges Tinubu to cut fuel prices and offers his ideas
items.s: Atiku Abubakar said palliatives cannot replace lower petrol prices and offered to share his proposals, telling the President he could rename them and take the credit.

items.h: Emir Sanusi urges Kano residents to buy Dangote refinery shares
items.s: Khalifa Muhammadu Sanusi II said Kano stands to benefit significantly from the IPO.

items.h: Dangote refinery sourced 60% of its crude locally
items.s: A report said the refinery relied on the naira-for-crude scheme for about 60 per cent of its feedstock in the year to June 2026.

items.h: Tinubu orders 180-day roadmap for Digital Free Zones
items.s: The President moved the initiative to its next phase to attract global technology jobs and investment.

items.h: $12m enterprise centre unveiled in Abuja
items.s: SMEDAN, UNDP and Korea's KOICA opened a centre to support small businesses.

items.h: 50MW power project to supply Idu industrial area
items.s: Ground was broken on a plant to give Abuja's Idu industries round-the-clock electricity.

items.h: KASU lecturers suspend strike
items.s: ASUU at Kaduna State University called off its strike after the state approved the 2025 salary agreement.

items.h: Gombe restricts movement for Saturday by-election
items.s: Police closed commercial activity in Gombe, Kwami and Funakaye for the federal constituency by-election.

items.h: ICPC questions Ekiti APC House candidate over alleged fraud
items.s: Toyin Okoro, the party's candidate for Ise-Orun/Ikere/Ekiti South-West, appeared before the commission.

items.h: Fitch says CBN holding company rules could force bank restructuring
items.s: The ratings agency said proposed rules may require banks to move foreign subsidiaries and reorganise.

items.h: Mafab plans to sell 5G assets to MTN
items.s: ThisDay reported that Mafab Communications intends to sell its $273.6 million 5G spectrum to MTN Nigeria.

items.h: Jonathan calls for unified federal and state civil service pay
items.s: Former President Goodluck Jonathan spoke in Yenagoa.

items.h: Police repatriate Chinese fugitive wanted over rosewood smuggling
items.s: Zhang Shijie was returned to Guangzhou through INTERPOL.

items.h: EFCC probes man caught with fake $212,200 in Kano
items.s: The commission's Kano office began investigating Usaini Ibrahim.

items.h: FG moves to clear Bida-Kutigi gridlock and Lagos truck parking
items.s: The President ordered urgent measures to restore traffic on the Niger State corridor.

items.h: Plateau cracks down on houses without toilets
items.s: Households in Jos South were given seven days to provide toilets or face prosecution.

items.h: Hajj operators demand probe of private slot allocation
items.s: Private operators asked the President to order a review of how 15,000 seats were shared.

items.h: Group urges Wike and APC to protect party unity
items.s: Renewed Hope Ambassadors' coordinators called for restraint in the dispute.

items.h: Edo council chairman criticised over party caps directive
items.s: Esan West's chairman was accused of barring drivers from wearing rival party caps.

items.h: Christian youths endorse APM's Haske in Adamawa
items.s: A youth group backed Abdulrahman Haske for governor.

items.h: KADGIS says it has resolved 5,000 land disputes
items.s: Kaduna's land agency also reinstated more than 150 revoked titles.

items.h: Finchglow plans flying school at Gateway Airport
items.s: The company seeks approval for pilot training in Ogun.

items.h: World Bank mobilises record $112bn in private capital
items.s: Africa drew $22 billion, nearly 150 per cent more than four years ago.

items.h: Mbappe leaves Nike for On
items.s: The France captain signed with the Swiss brand as it enters football.
